title_zh: 了解全职工作坊岗位的资格与工作要求

scenario.label_zh: 了解全职工作坊岗位的资格与工作要求
scenario.goal_zh: 核对学历替代条件和教学职责，了解工作要求后索取岗位说明

context_zh: 求职者咨询一所成人教育中心的工作坊教师岗位。
author: author-phase07-c

sentences.speaker: David
sentences.text: Is this a full-time post, or would I only come in to teach the evening workshops?

sentences.speaker: Priya
sentences.text: It is full-time. Preparation, equipment checks and meetings are included in the working week.

sentences.speaker: David
sentences.text: I have a technical certificate. Would you accept a qualification equivalent to the diploma in the advertisement?

sentences.speaker: Priya
sentences.text: Yes. We also need practical expertise, so please include examples of work you have done.

sentences.speaker: David
sentences.text: I have supervised a repair team, but I have not taught a large class.

sentences.speaker: Priya
sentences.text: Your fellow instructors would help you plan the first sessions. We do not expect you to work alone from day one.

sentences.speaker: David
sentences.text: What is your main expectation of someone new to the role?

sentences.speaker: Priya
sentences.text: A strong work ethic, including turning up prepared and asking for help before a problem gets worse.

sentences.speaker: David
sentences.text: I want to understand the role fully before I apply. Could you send the job description?

sentences.speaker: Priya
sentences.text: Certainly. It explains the duties you would need to fulfil, including the equipment checks.

sentences.speaker: David
sentences.text: Thank you. I will read that and decide whether my experience is a good match.

sentences.speaker: Priya
sentences.text: I will email it this afternoon.

targets.sense_zh: 同事中的，共同从事某活动的
行为准则；此处指工作态度
